prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ph.product_id, 0) AS product_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) AS views,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) AS added_to_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 3 THEN 1 END) AS purchases
FROM shopping_cart_events se
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
WHERE se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY ph.product_id
ORDER BY product_id

[B]
SQL:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        sh.event_type,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events sh
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sh.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE sh.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, sh.event_type
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as page_views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as added_to_cart,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as purchases,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart
FROM product_events
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

SQL:
WITH page_to_product AS (
    SELECT page_id, product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
    WHERE page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
event_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.page_id,
        p.product_id,
        e.event_type,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN page_to_product p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY p.page_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as cart_additions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as purchases,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart_without_purchase
FROM event_counts
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id
